# M4 — Documents core — module report (in progress)

## T-004 — Refunds via credit notes (BK-006 · OQ-012) — DONE 2026-10-28
**What was built.** A refund on an issued invoice is a credit note (avoir), never a payment reversal (OQ-012). The invoice detail offers "Établir un avoir" on paid and partially paid invoices; the amount is capped by a single tested rule, and the avoir is created as a draft that follows the normal credit lifecycle (send → apply to another invoice, or keep as client credit).

**Rule.** GIVEN an invoice WHEN a credit note is issued THEN the amount may not exceed: the amount actually received when the invoice is paid; the open balance when it is sent or partially paid; nothing at all for drafts and cancelled invoices. Over-ceiling requests are refused (409 AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE); a non-positive amount is a validation error (422).

**Checks run.** 65/65 unit tests (4 new), typecheck and build clean. Live walk against the local Worker [EXECUTED]: paid invoice FAC-2026-0038 (28 450 XPF) → request 28 451 → 409; request 10 000 → 201, avoir AV-2026-0026 draft with balance 10 000 and one explanation line; request 0 → 422; activity journal shows `activity.credit_created_from_invoice`.

**Deviations.** The audit's original acceptance ("payment shows partially refunded") is not applicable under OQ-012 and was replaced by the credit-note ceiling rule above. Silent clamping was removed in favour of an explicit refusal (hiding a user error was a defect risk).

**Could not verify.** Browser-side rendering of the new modal (no browser in this environment); its data path is covered by the API walk.
